{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.et:

{07 14 00}Thank you!{01 00 00 0a 00} I think I just

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Thank you, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 14 00} I'm
so grateful that you came
to visit me.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Aitäh, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 14 00} Ma olen
nii tänulik, et sa tulid
mind vaatama.

me, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}! I'm going
to be just fine. {01 00 00 0a 00}I think.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Aitäh, et minu pärast
muretsed, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}! Minuga
saab kõik korda. {01 00 00 0a 00}Vist.
